match.userMessage: Storyboard animatic frame. medium. eye level. SCARLETT stands at the curb in the foreground as commuters gather around her and the walk signal is visible across the street. SCARLETT has finished the touch-up, lipstick in hand, hair lifted slightly by the wind. Then: SCARLETT laughs, caps and pockets the lipstick, then moves with the crowd as the signal changes. Camera: follow, accelerating into the walk. Let the gust lift her hair before the crowd carries her forward. Characters: Scarlett: Woman, 22, A striking, fresh-faced 22-year-old beauty creator: dewy, even skin, high cheekbones, wide dark eyes and a sleek dark bob, wearing Black fitted turtleneck, slim black trousers, small gold hoop earrings. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, correct perspective and depth, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Figures have readable poses, gestures and simple expressive faces. Draw the single opening moment of the shot: each character appears exactly once, and what happens next is shown only by a few bold arrows for the camera move and the way subjects travel. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
